title: Skills & Perks
content:
mcMMO skills are live now: 19 skills and 83 perks, and levels run from 1 to 1,000. The game announces each new perk in chat the moment you unlock it.

Check yours any time:
/mcstats shows all your levels.
Typing a skill's name (like /smelting) shows that skill's own page.
/mctop shows the leaderboards.

Magic is awake: 1 of 5 seals broken. Get your first wand from the Old Quartermaster in the spawn village. More spells open as each seal falls. Tap Spellbook in the menu to see your wand's spells.
